neighbours.label: 'whatever' in an aside (whatever it may be, whatever color), with an inserted 'for example'; 'however' and plain phrases stay quiet
fire: Your first job, whatever it may be, teaches you a lot.
Her hair has a reddish tint (whatever shade it turns later).
Cheese differs by region, with Dutch brands, for example, using less salt.
Their next move, whatever it is, will be costly.
The puppy has a dark coat (whatever colour it will be grown).
Our main goal, whatever the cost, is to finish.
Rules vary, with French schools, for example, starting later.
This tool, whatever you call it, works well.
quiet: Your first job, however dull it is, teaches you a lot.
Her hair has a reddish tint in the evening sun.
Cheese differs by region and by the age of the milk.
Their next move, however small, will be costly.
The puppy has a dark coat and white paws.
Our main goal this year is to finish.
Rules vary a little between French and Dutch schools.
This tool, which I bought, works well.
